description: This file is part of the vtiger CRM project and handles the management of layout blocks and custom fields in the CRM's settings module. It includes functions for retrieving, updating, adding, deleting, and reordering layout blocks and custom fields, as well as managing related list configurations and field properties.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Custom Smarty class used for rendering templates within vtiger CRM.

methods.name: getFieldListEntries
methods.description: Retrieves the list of custom fields grouped by blocks for a specific module, including field properties and visibility settings.

methods.name: getRelatedListInfo
methods.description: Fetches information about related lists associated with a specific module.

methods.name: changeRelatedListOrder
methods.description: Reorders related list entries for a module based on user actions (move up/down).

methods.name: addCustomField
methods.description: Creates a new custom field in the specified module with properties such as type, label, and associated picklist values.

methods.name: deleteCustomField
methods.description: Removes a custom field from a module, including all related database entries and associated picklist tables.

methods.name: addblock
methods.description: Adds a new layout block to a module at a specified position.

methods.name: deleteBlock
methods.description: Deletes a custom layout block from the database.

methods.name: show_move_hiddenfields
methods.description: Handles moving fields between visible and hidden states within layout blocks.

methods.name: updateFieldProperties
methods.description: Updates properties of an existing custom field, such as mandatory status, default value, and display settings.

methods.name: changeFieldOrder
methods.description: Reorders fields or blocks within a module layout based on user input.
